turns.text: Oh dear. Act fast, ink sets over time. Dab a cotton bud with a little rubbing alcohol and touch only the ink lines.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Test it on a hidden spot first, like the back. And dab, don't rub, or you'll spread it.

turns.text: Oh, and another thing. I teach year nine and I'm showing a film on the last day of term. Help me pick.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Last day energy is usually low and chatty. I'd go with the space survival film, it's gripping without being heavy. Keep the courtroom drama for a normal lesson where you can discuss it properly.
